title: Three sentences on iman
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Spring 1: The six pillars of iman
source: Written for islamic-studies/y2 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: three sentences on iman)
intro: Lesson 13: Belief in the messengers, the Last Day and qadar. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Allah's messengers
points: Allah sent messengers to every people

panels.title: The Last Day
points: One day this world will end

keywords.def: a person Allah chose to teach people His message
the day everyone will stand before Allah

questions.q: Say all six pillars of iman.
questions.a: Allah, angels, books, messengers, Last Day, qadar

questions.q: Write one sentence for each: messengers, Last Day, qadar.
questions.a: For example: Allah sent messengers to teach us. On the Last Day we stand before Allah. Qadar means Allah has a plan.

questions.q: Stretch: why do we say in sha Allah when we plan?
questions.a: Because only Allah knows what will happen.

questions.q: It rains on your picnic day. What should a Muslim do?
options: Say alhamdulillah and make a new plan
questions.a: A) Say alhamdulillah and make a new plan. Belief in qadar means trusting Allah's plan and trying again.

questions.q: Think again: rain on picnic day is ...
questions.a: Part of Allah's plan; we say alhamdulillah and try again.
